scope: Unimplemented local probability toy. Three eligible single-target actors plus the same commander. All naturally choose A; commander asks B. Damage and obedience numbers are invented illustrations, not game character stats or observed rarity rates. The distribution records POTENTIAL packets before HP caps and death/retargeting. The probability that packets can meet a threshold is meaningful only with no intervening enemy actions/healing or other effects. Once B dies, remaining real actions should use normal retargeting, so values above its HP are not actual HP damage. Metrics are requested-target threshold probability, NOT battle win probability.
same_target_control: If the normal target is already B, no obedience roll and no change-trigger. This toy does not model the future fixed-capacity occupancy cost; the chosen capacity remains reserved even when no change occurs.
